title: Which Fictional Soulmate Is Your Perfect Match?
description: Discover which fictional character would be your ideal romantic partner based on your personality and preferences.

options.text: A quiet dinner under the stars
Traveling to an exotic location together
Cozy movie night with homemade popcorn
An unexpected adventure where we nearly get caught
Through small daily acts of care

questions.text: What attracts you most in a person?

options.text: A sense of danger and excitement

questions.text: What's your biggest fear in a relationship?
If your partner needed you, you would...

options.text: Drop everything and rush to their side
Write them a heartfelt letter or song
Plan an epic escape or adventure together
Research solutions and help them practically

questions.text: What do you value most in a partner?

options.text: Say sorry first but suggest an adventure

romantic_hero.title: The Romantic Hero
romantic_hero.description: Your perfect match is a classic romantic hero - think Mr. Darcy, Prince Charming, or Jamie Fraser. They're devoted, protective, and believe in grand love that stands the test of time.

protective_hero.title: The Protective Hero
protective_hero.description: You need a partner who will always put your safety first. Your match is someone like Captain America or Jean Valjean - strong, reliable, and willing to protect you at all costs.

soulmate_artist.title: The Soulmate Artist
soulmate_artist.description: You crave deep emotional connection. Your match is a creative soul like Jack Dawson, Christian Grey, or Day 6 from 'The Vampire Diaries' - intense, passionate, and devastatingly romantic.

adventure_partner.title: The Adventure Partner
adventure_partner.description: Life with you is never boring. Your match is someone who lives for excitement - like Jack Sparrow, Han Solo, or Dmitri - spontaneous, daring, and always up for the next thrill.

bad_boy.title: The Bad Boy with a Heart
bad_boy.description: You love the thrill of taming a wild heart. Your match has an edge - like Draco Malfoy, Mr. Grey, or Beast - secretly soft beneath the tough exterior.

intellectual.title: The Intellectual Equal
intellectual.description: You need someone who can match your mind. Your match is a brilliant soul like Dr. Strange, Sherlock, or Edward Cullen - smart, sophisticated, and forever intriguing.

sweet_nerd.title: The Sweet Nerd
sweet_nerd.description: Your perfect match is adorably awkward and genuinely kind. Think Ron Weasley, Ted Mosby, or Pete L. - lovable, loyal, and always putting a smile on your face.
examples: Ted Mosby (How I Met Your Mother)
